description: A dark, painterly night scene. In the foreground on a wooden desk, a hand feeds a sheet of paper into a grey shredder that spills long white paper strips; a tall stack of binders and folders sits beside it under a brass desk lamp. Through a large window, a grey military cargo plane with its rear ramp open stands on a wet tarmac, with a wooden crate banded in metal straps and a cart of missiles in front, and two dark figures walking across the apron.
